description.value: Liquor World is a liquor store located inside Lansdowne Mall (next to JYSK) in Richmond, offering a curated selection of wines, spirits, and local and imported beers. The store positions itself as quality-focused, sourcing products from local BC brewers and wineries alongside international spirits. A touring cyclist passing through Richmond's busy No. 3 Road corridor would find a well-stocked stop for provisions.

address.value: 5300 Number 3 Road Unit 868, Richmond, BC V6X 2X9

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 31m; rack at 56m.
